filter_repo_objects_allow_patterns: filter repo objects using allow_patterns to select items matching glob patterns like *.pdf
filter_repo_objects_ignore_patterns: filter repo objects using ignore_patterns to exclude items matching glob patterns like .*
filter_repo_objects_key_argument: filter repo objects with a key function to extract string paths from custom objects for pattern matching
filter_repo_objects_folder_patterns: filter repo objects using folder-based allow_patterns to select items under a specific directory path
filter_repo_objects_default_ignore: filter repo objects using DEFAULT_IGNORE_PATTERNS to exclude .git and .cache/huggingface directories
